objective: Determine whether the identical preregistered v1 architecture, authenticated data, split, sentinel sets, optimizer, schedule, full-training recipe, gates, replication rule, and sealed rule can learn the teacher ordering when only the loss objective is changed to listwise 1.0, domain-microaveraged pair 1.0, tie-aware hardest-negative margin 1.0, move value 0.20, and state value 0.0.
claim_boundary: Passing the known-tune gate shows offline representation capacity only. It is not playing-strength, Elo, rank, browser-runtime, distillation, quantization, WASM, match, live-weight, or deployment evidence.

fixed_from_v1.rule: Everything except the loss objective is identical to capacity-policy-value-v1-plan. No architecture, input, data, exclusion, partition, split, sentinel set, seed, optimizer, learning-rate, batch, epoch, full-training, selection, gate, replication, sealed, or production condition may change.

v1_result.role: fixed spent development evidence only; v1 is closed and this receipt cannot authorize a v1 retry, v1 continuation, v2 full training, second seed, sealed labels, live integration, or deployment

design_firewall.allowed_basis: Only the fixed v1 sentinel training result and the mechanics of the v1 loss objective were used to preregister the v2 objective.
forbidden_design_inputs: known-eval labels, records, candidate scores, or outcomes
Browser or V9 tune labels, candidate scores, or outcomes
sealed labels, records, candidate scores, or outcomes
design_firewall.assertion: No known-eval, tune, or sealed evidence was inspected or used to choose the v2 objective, weights, architecture, recipe, thresholds, or stopping rules. Their registered identities and unchanged gates are carried forward only as a fail-closed provenance and future-evaluation contract.

closed_lanes: Do not rerun the rejected board all-legal warm-start recipe.
Do not rerun the rejected 35,307-parameter explicit residual recipe.
Do not use the already observed 643-parent browser reject or 4,798-parent V9 selection as final evidence.
Do not generate sealed labels, add seeds, extend epochs, relax thresholds, distill, integrate, match, or deploy after a failed registered gate.
Treat capacity-policy-value-v1 as permanently closed after its registered complete-sentinel-rejected result; do not retry, extend, retune, continue, or reuse its weights.
If v2 misses any sentinel check, STOP before full training, seed 314159, sealed labels, live integration, or deployment.

If v2 fails after the sentinel, STOP the remaining second-seed, sealed, and live lanes as applicable; the only next capacity diagnostic allowed by this plan is a separately preregistered small child-board encoder diagnostic.

live_nnue.role: frozen exact production child-score anchor; never trainable or writable

browser_training.role: all rules-complete legal moves independently depth-12 rescored

v9_training.role: depth-14 proposal plus independently depth-16-rescored played move

architecture.input: side-to-move-normalized 28 piece occupancy planes, 14 physically normalized hand-count planes, and one clipped exact-ply plane
architecture.state_encoder: 64-channel stem, six residual blocks, flattened 384-dimensional global state
architecture.move_encoder: source/destination spatial features plus explicit move categories and tanh(exact live parent-view child CP / 3000), 721 to 256
architecture.legal_move_set: four permutation-equivariant Transformer encoder layers, d_model 256, eight heads, FFN 1024, padding mask, no positional embedding
architecture.outputs: unclipped unquantized learned policy residual added to the frozen exact live CP anchor, plus an offline parent value
architecture.production_constraints: none; this is a capacity diagnostic and cannot be loaded by the browser

training.sentinel_policy: lexicographically lowest retained fit parent IDs; discard sentinel weights
training.mixed_parent_ratio: every Browser fit parent exactly once and exactly three rotating V9 fit parents per Browser parent per epoch
training.checkpoint: atomic last checkpoint every mixed epoch and immutable best checkpoint
training.selection: maximize Browser tune top1 gain, then Browser pair gain, then V9 top1 gain
training.replication: run seed 314159 only if seed 42 passes every capacity-tune check; do not rerun the sentinel

browser_tune.mean_regret: must not exceed the registered exact live baseline

gates.replication: seed 314159 must independently pass the identical capacity_tune gate

clean_derivative.policy: drop an entire source game if any parent or rules-complete legal child semantic ID intersects the preregistered known-eval union; preserve surviving raw lines byte-for-byte

teacher_after_candidate_freeze.selection: sort each clean parent by sha256('capacity-sealed-v1:' + parent_id), take at most four per game, then take the lowest 512 globally
teacher_after_candidate_freeze.labels: enumerate every rules-complete legal move and independently rescore each child with the pinned YaneuraOu depth-12 teacher used by the Browser dataset
teacher_after_candidate_freeze.parallelism: independent parent shards may run in parallel after both capacity seeds pass

loss.parent_weighting: Browser and V9 remain separate padded microbatches. Listwise, tie-aware hardest-negative margin, and move-value terms contribute one equal value per parent; the pair term is microaveraged over all eligible ordered pairs inside each domain microbatch.
loss.listwise: teacher relative CP clamped to [-2000,0], softmax temperature 100 CP, equal-parent mean, weight 1.0
loss.pair: all ordered teacher gaps at least 50 CP, logistic softplus, microaverage across all eligible ordered pairs in the current Browser or V9 domain microbatch, weight 1.0
loss.tie_aware_hardest_negative_margin: teacher-max ties form the complete best set and are excluded from negatives; compare max predicted CP within that best set against max predicted CP among all non-best legal moves, apply ReLU(50 CP - (best-set predicted max - non-best predicted max)) / 100 CP, equal-parent mean, weight 1.0; a parent with no non-best move contributes exact zero
loss.move_value: SmoothL1 of predicted and teacher move CP clamped to +/-3000 and scaled by 600, beta 0.25, equal-parent mean, weight 0.20
loss.state_value: same v1 parent-value target and scaling, weight 0.0; the state-value head remains architecturally present but this objective supplies it no direct loss

failure_conditions: STOP before optimizer creation on any byte, hash, count, schema, source role, child transition, protected union, partition, split, sentinel, or live-baseline drift.
STOP before full training if either sentinel domain misses top1 or pair requirements; discard its weights.
STOP after seed 42 on any capacity-tune miss; do not start seed 314159.
STOP after seed 314159 on any replication miss; do not generate sealed labels.
STOP after any sealed miss; do not distill, quantize, integrate, match, change live weights, or deploy.
No static pass authorizes a playing-strength or high-dan claim.
v1 is closed: its spent result cannot be retried, continued, promoted, or used to authorize any downstream lane.
Any v2 sentinel miss ends v2 before full training; any later v2 gate miss ends the remaining second-seed, sealed, live-weight, and deployment lanes.
After a v2 failure, do not make another objective-only retry. The only next capacity experiment permitted here is a separately preregistered small child-board encoder diagnostic.
